title: Nico Bravo
overview: There is a superstore called Vulcan's Celestial Supply, where all of the universe's heroes, gods and monsters go to buy their next-level weapons and quest-gear. Fierce fighters outside the store, inside they're calm and quiet thanks the fast mind of the store's head clerk Nico Bravo, the very mortal son of the god Vulcan, the store's owner. So, when Vulcan is suddenly kidnapped, it's up to Nico to gather his band of clerks, arm-up with the shop's best merch, and set out to save the world by rescuing Vulcan from The God Of Evil.
